infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Health Sync reads your activity, sleep, and vitals so it can merge them with your Google/Fitbit data without double counting.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Health Sync writes activity recorded by your other devices into Apple Health so both platforms show your complete history.
